original.target_description: Experiment 3 comparison of disgust and moral judgment across harm/incest and intent: judgment-by-domain and judgment-by-intent interactions and multiple simple comparisons fit description.

notes: Identity verified within supplied text: title When ignorance is no excuse: Different roles for intent across moral domains; authors Liane Young and Rebecca Saxe; Cognition 120 (2011) 202–214; doi:10.1016/j.cognition.2011.04.005.
